newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures jump higher on close, spec buying.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures jump higher on close, spec buying.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled firmer and over resistance after late-session speculative buying ran through stops and pushed benchmark May through key 85.00 cents, traders said.
Volume was estimated at only 2,000 lots compared with Monday's official 1,444 lots.
"(Today's gains) were in a vacuum -- a lack of selling combined with spec buying that suddenly came in at end," Dean Witter vice president Celeste Georgakis, said.
She said the close was constructive nonetheless, and pegged the next upside target at 88.00 cents in May.
The longer-term outlook remains negative, with world supplies outpacing demand.
"We are still getting overhead resistance from the fundamentals," Georgakis said.
May juice ended 1.95 cents firmer at 85.60 cents per pound, having ranged from 86.00 to 82.30 cents. The back months settled 1.70 to 0.20 higher.
The locals were cited on both sides of the market early, as prices lingered below unchanged, traders said.
